title: Cyber-Physical RSI for AI-RAN: A Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.25619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned models for radio access networks (RANs) are often developed using simulation, yet their predictions can shift when exposed to physical propagation conditions, protocol behavior, and equipment implementations. This paper presents a cyber-physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework for AI-RAN that connects a task-oriented student model, an experiment-planning coach agent, a calibratable virtual environment, and a physical host agent. Physical measurements are organized as evidence for both model adaptation and subsequent experiment planning. We examine an implementation of the physical-feedback pathway using ping-pong handover as a case study. The system completes 12 physical executions organized into six baseline--candidate pairs, updates the student from measured outcomes, and evaluates the revised model on reserved physical configurations. In the observed short-window tests, increasing the time-to-trigger from 320 to 128

translated_title: 面向AI无线接入网络的信息物理递归自我改进：案例研究
translated_abstract: 面向无线接入网络的习得模型通常基于仿真开发，然而当其暴露于真实物理传播条件、协议行为和设备实现时，其预测结果可能发生偏移。本文提出了一种面向AI-RAN的信息物理递归自我改进（RSI）框架，该框架将面向任务的学生模型、实验规划教练智能体、可校准的虚拟环境以及物理宿主智能体连接起来。物理测量结果被组织为证据，既用于模型自适应，也用于后续的实验规划。我们以乒乓切换为案例研究，考察了物理反馈通路的实现。该系统完成了12次物理执行（组织为六组基线-候选对），根据测量结果更新学生模型，并在预留的物理配置上评估修订后的模型。在观察到的短窗口测试中，将触发时间从320增加到128……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向AI-RAN的信息物理递归自我改进框架，将物理测量结果作为证据同时驱动模型自适应与实验规划，并通过乒乓切换案例研究验证了物理反馈通路的有效性。
